items.excerpt: zplane released PEEL STEMS 2, a major update to its real-time AI stem separation plugin for macOS and Windows that cuts processing latency and improves separation quality while working directly inside DAW sessions.

TV writer Simon Balch formed The Bootleg Velvet Sundown, a human tribute band rivaling the AI-generated group The Velvet Sundown, pledging all profits to real musicians 'whose work AI stole in the first place.'

Musixmatch announced the winners of its first AI-focused 'Musicathon': 523 developers built 100+ AI tools in seven days, with winning projects including Fusion Karaoke (lyrics-reactive AI visuals), Lyri (AI songwriting assistant) and SoundClash (AI voice-recognition music quiz).

Sydney booking agency Good Intent apologised after unknowingly booking 'Afro Charles' — an entirely AI-generated artist — onto a live venue lineup, pledging to overhaul vetting processes as musicians called the deception 'a complete insult' to human performers.

Tracktion released Waveform 14 with an LLM-driven AI Assistant that answers questions from the manual, generates MIDI sequences and analyses clips to create complementary parts — running on a BYOK pay-as-you-go model supporting OpenAI and Anthropic APIs.

Yamaha expanded its Creator Pass subscription with Cubase 15 AI, Ableton Live 12 Lite and a $9.99 Starter plan aimed at first-time creators who want AI-assisted songwriting, beat-building and idea-generation tools without DAW experience.
The Quantum MIDI Sequencer is a generative music sequencer that translates nuclear radiation events into MIDI notes, turning true physical randomness into an algorithmic composition source.

Sound designer Fabio Gotti details building his debut HydraTek plugin Erebos as a deliberately human-made product, warning that audio tools and marketing 'can quickly collapse into generic AI-generated aesthetics' — a counterpoint craft story to the vibe-coded plugin wave.

Australia's leading music and creative organisations launched a united campaign demanding federal copyright protections after local songs were allegedly used to train AI models without consent, calling it 'the largest theft of intellectual property in our history.'

Hypebot examines whether audiences genuinely oppose AI in music creation or whether the backlash mirrors the resistance that met every past technology shift in production — a question shaping how openly working musicians disclose AI use.
